quest.title: As the Courtyard in Spring Once Appeared
quest.description: The first day on the island was rather peaceful, yet things start to get strange the next morning... and this seems to only be the beginning. You and the others trace the strange phenomena to an island and find a bonsai that is not supposed to be there.
quest.rewards_formatted: Primogem x30, Mora x20000, Hero's Wit x2, Leisurely Rocks: Left x1, Leisurely Rocks: Right x1

chapter.title: As the Courtyard in Spring Once Appeared

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Well, I certainly didn't expect to see you here.

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: This is a bonsai pot, right? It's nice, but it looks like it's been a little neglected.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: An illusion? No... it felt too real to be an illusion.

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: Those things we saw flickering in and out, that's exactly what I saw earlier this morning!

dialogues.speaker: Fischl
dialogues.text: Does this mean... the Immernachtreich... is real?

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Wait, what?

dialogues.speaker: Fischl
dialogues.text: Ahem!

dialogues.speaker: Fischl
dialogues.text: Hehe! Behold, the Immernachtreich has come, just as your Prinzessin had prophesied! Come, my people, a new chapter awaits us!

dialogues.speaker: Oz
dialogues.text: Indeed, mein Fräulein. We all have witnessed this miracle with our own eyes, and now is the time to celebrate the creation of a new world! Rejoice!

dialogues.speaker: Fischl
dialogues.text: Hahahaha, welcome to the Immernachtreich!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: She looks so happy, Paimon doesn't have the heart to interrupt her right now...

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: She doesn't seem surprised in the slightest. Does that just come with being an experienced adventurer, or...?

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: If this isn't an illusion, we ought to go and investigate.

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: I got an idea. If you hurt yourself in a dream, you wake up right away, don't ya?

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Hmm? Yes, you have a point.

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Right? So c'mon, Kazuha, hit me.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Uh... I'd rather not... How about you hit me instead?

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: But that'll hurt real bad.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey! There'll be no need for any of that!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Just leave it to us! Hey {NICKNAME}, can Paimon hit you?

response.speaker: Fantastic Boat
response.text: Haha, I like yer senses o' humor, me hearties. An illusion? So, talking boats and squirrels are just an illusion to humans, huh.

response.speaker: Squirrel
response.text: Now, now, it's understandable, old chap. Haven't you heard? As humans grow older, they forget many important things and lose many of their abilities.

response.speaker: Fantastic Boat
response.text: Aye, so they do... A pity, to be sure. Thinking back, in all those years I spent sailing with the fleet, I would've never imagined that one day I'd be laughing over something like this.

response.speaker: Fantastic Boat
response.text: Well then, me lads and lasses, don't you want to take a wee gander at all the places you're so curious about?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Of course! But how do we get there?

response.speaker: Fantastic Boat
response.text: Look! Here!

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: At what?

response.speaker: Fantastic Boat
response.text: Blimey, at me, of course! Oh, that's right, I forgot to introduce myself. I'm the smartest ship you'll find in all these parts! The name's... argh, just call me whatever takes yer fancy.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Don't you have a name?

response.speaker: Fantastic Boat
response.text: That I do, I just can't remember it. All I know is that I came here from Inazuma.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: In that case, Paimon shall name you... "Miitoboru"! How's that? All the other ships in Inazuma seem to have names ending in "ru," too.

response.speaker: Fantastic Boat
response.text: Miitoboru? Haha, that'll do nicely.

response.speaker: Miitoboru
response.text: You're lucky to have met me. I can sail through the choppiest seas with ease, there isn't a wave out there that can capsize me! So...

response.speaker: Miitoboru
response.text: Come aboard, and I'll take you wherever you'd like to go!

response.speaker: Squirrel
response.text: Ah, how very kind of you, old chap. Unlike that Anemo Archon who abandoned us here.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: The Anemo Archon?

response.speaker: Squirrel
response.text: You know, the Anemo Archon of Mondstadt.

response.speaker: Squirrel
response.text: Don't you know? Some of these islands used to be Mondstadt's mountaintops. Once upon a time, the Anemo Archon sliced them off to neaten the place up, and chucked them into the ocean.

response.speaker: Squirrel
response.text: My great-great-great-great-great-great... great grandfather was on one of the mountaintops, and got sent flying here along with it. Wretched Anemo Archon!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: How could that happen!

response.speaker: Squirrel
response.text: And we've been living here for generations since then, haha. Fortunately, there were a few other squirrel families that got stranded on these islands as well, so we built ourselves a kingdom here.

response.speaker: Squirrel
response.text: The good thing is that there are no predators or competitors around. All the pinecones on this island are ours for the taking. The bad thing is... we're stuck here.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Didn't see that coming... Sounds like the Immernachtreich is a kingdom of squirrels!

response.speaker: Fischl
response.text: Hold thy tongue!

response.speaker: Oz
response.text: Paimon, please do not make such slanderous statements. The Immernachtreich is, of course, a kingdom of night ravens.

response.speaker: Miitoboru
response.text: Hey, lad, yes, you! You're from Inazuma, aye? That makes us brothers, haha. Every young lad of Inazuma has to pluck up the courage to set sail on an adventure one day! So, are you coming?

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: To set sail... is to leave one's homeland and travel far away.

response.speaker: Miitoboru
response.text: Aye, you need lots of courage and just a dash of heartlessness. 'Cause once you leave, you may never return. But if you stay, you're forever a prisoner in your own heart.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: ...Huh. Inspiring words, Miitoboru. And you're right. The wanderer's spirit runs in my blood. I'll go with you.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: My friends, are you coming too? I want to take a look at the strange phenomena on that island.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: Also, I smell ancient timber and waterproof varnish on this boat... The scent is indeed from Inazuma, so I believe he speaks the truth.

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: Hmm... what does everyone think?

response.speaker: Fischl
response.text: Oz, lay down the gangplank! Thy Prinzessin shall take to the seas!

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: Let's all go! It'll definitely be an experience.

response.speaker: Miitoboru
response.text: Haha, great! Aaand we're off!

response.speaker: Squirrel
response.text: Safe travels!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It looks like this letter was written by Kazuha's father.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So keeping bonsai plants really does run in the family.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm... But the fact that we're even here and could see his father's notes... It just seems so unbelievable.

talks.objective: Go to the island where the strange phenomena occurred

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: So the bonsai pot belonged to your ancestors? Seems a shame to leave it empty like this.

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Hmm, Kazuha, what do you think about maybe putting a little something inside it?

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Alright.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Though I still don't understand why it has appeared here, I can give that a try.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Eek!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon knew it wasn't gonna be that simple.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Where's Kazuha?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? Oh yeah... everyone's here... except for Kazuha!

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Kazuha! Where are you? Are you okay?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: No response. Well, let's keep an eye out for him.

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: Look at the decor here... it's like the inside of a grand mansion. I don't think this is a perilous maze — it's somebody's home.

dialogues.speaker: Fischl
dialogues.text: Most curious. What secrets lie within this place, I shall surely uncover.

talks.objective: Operate the device and investigate further

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kageharu
dialogues.text: Father, what are you carving?

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Hisamichi
dialogues.text: Haha, it's a rock garden. I'm modeling it after the scenery I saw on my travels abroad. It'll go in my bonsai later.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Hisamichi
dialogues.text: Work has been so busy these years, I've barely had a moment to spend with my grandson. I hope he doesn't take after me... when he's older, he should get out there and see more of the world.

talks.objective: Enter the corridor and explore further

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: This bonsai... was in my family for many generations. Sadly, it ended up in a Tenryou Commission warehouse in my generation.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Haha, one thing you might not know about my past is that I spent some time as one of Inazuma's most wanted fugitives. I suspect this bonsai was confiscated during my long time on the run.

dialogues.speaker: Fischl
dialogues.text: Fugitive...

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: *sigh* ...Life throws all kinds of hardships at us. I doubt a single person in this world lives a truly carefree life.

talks.objective: Investigate your surroundings and find a way to open the door

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: This bonsai... was in my family for many generations. I saw it once in a Tenryou Commission warehouse, but it looked quite different from how it does now.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: At that time, there was a withered tree inside.

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: Why would someone keep the plant in there if it's dead?

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: It's a way of sending a secret message. It indicated that there was something hidden inside the flowerpot.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: There was a letter buried down at the bottom, which told of an ancient secret in my clan. I did not take the bonsai with me after reading the letter, which means it should still be in the warehouse now.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: I wonder who removed the plant and placed the pot here...

talks.objective: Operate the device and investigate further

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: To hide the letter with that secret in, right?

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Yes, and to give his son something to remember him by.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: My grandfather returned as quickly as he could, but my great-grandfather had already passed away. They never got the chance to say goodbye to each other before the end. After that, my grandfather would spend long periods of time standing in front of this bonsai, lost in thought.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Eventually, he started to make his own bonsai. Unlike his father, he preferred arranging rock gardens instead of plants.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Perhaps influenced by my grandfather, my father also took a liking to crafting bonsai. Back then, our courtyard was filled with all kinds of them.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Hisamichi
dialogues.text: The flesh resides in society, while the heart yearns for the natural world... Such has been the way of the Kaedeharas for many generations.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Hisamichi
dialogues.text: Kazuha, the future of this clan will one day be in your hands.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Hisamichi
dialogues.text: When that time comes, remember to always stay true to yourself.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Hisamichi
dialogues.text: Listen carefully, Kazuha. A Kaedehara blade is not forged for the purpose of harming people.

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Oh there you are!

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Huh? Where did you all go?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: This place is a maze! We all got trapped inside, except for you.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: I've been stuck in this room the whole time, and can't seem to find a way out. I have to say, this place looks a lot like my childhood bedroom.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: If this is your home, why would you be trapped here? Is the maze trying to keep you out?

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You tell Kazuha about everything that just happened...

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: It appears that this whole maze is modeled after my family home. And all the conversations you heard in there are in fact words once spoken by my father and grandfather.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: You said that the maze is trying to keep me out... Indeed, I'm the only one unable to explore this place.

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: I think these unusual structures are some kind of mirage. According to what Kazuha said, all this seems to be constructed based on Kazuha's memory.

dialogues.speaker: Fischl
dialogues.text: But why should Lord Kazuha be the only one excluded?

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: ...Maybe that comes from me, too.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: To me, what is past is gone. Everything in the world is guided by its own rules, and as for people... we can never relive the past.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: I think that this belief is the reason why the mirage was keeping me out.

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: I can get behind that. It's a very sensible way of looking at things.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: All our thoughts have consequences. I don't consider it strange, and I don't think it's anything you should be worried about.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Hmm... we got in here by touching the bonsai, didn't we? So perhaps if we touch it again...

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: And this flowerpot was passed down to me as a family treasure.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: It's certainly no coincidence that it appeared here and became the entrance to the mirage. It's almost as if... it's giving me a chance to make up for past regrets.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Regrets about what?

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: There was once a time when the Kaedeharas were an illustrious clan in Inazuma.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: After the Raiden Gokaden incident, our clan's fortunes took a turn for the worse. By the time of my generation, our downfall was complete.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Later, I fled Inazuma as I didn't want be arrested. With no one left in the Kaedehara Clan, the authorities confiscated everything in our home, including this bonsai.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Like my ancestors before me, I think I'd like to try it out for myself... recreate a favorite scene from my travels and place it into this pot.

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: ... *sigh*

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Since the contents of this bonsai affect the mirage, I'd at least like to try my hand at making something.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: But what style? Should I use plants for the bonsai like my great-grandfather, or rocks like my father and grandfather...

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: ...Perhaps a rock garden would suit me better.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So do you need any supplies to make this bonsai?

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: I think I'll need a set of tools and some rocks that can be carved and made into decorations.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Got it, we'll help you look!

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: We might just get lucky. If the pot's here, then surely other stuff related to crafting bonsai can't be far away.

dialogues.speaker: Fischl
dialogues.text: I concur! Lord Kazuha, take heart in your search, for my retinue and I shall help you retrieve your missing treasures.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Thank you, everyone.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Still half-asleep, you can make out the sound of people talking. Then, you are greeted by the voice of a panicked Paimon trying to stay calm...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: ...Up! Wake up!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, wake up!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, thank goodness you're awake! Uh, Paimon has good news and bad news. Which one do you wanna hear first?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Aaah! Okay, okay, Paimon's sorry! Wake up, something's happened!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Go on, I'm listening.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Okay, uh, bad news first. The bad news is... something weird's going on with this island.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: And the good news is, is... it seems like it has nothing to do with what we came across yesterday. Today, is a different issue entirely.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: And what might that be?
#Ah, look, {M#he}{F#she}'s awake!
#Careful not to frighten {M#him}{F#her}. {M#He}{F#She}'s probably just like the others. Ah, humans... such delicate little things.
How're ya doing, mate? Feeling a little fragile?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So as you can see, the boat can talk, heh.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I might just go back to sleep for a bit...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: No, avoidance isn't gonna solve anything!

response.speaker: Squirrel
response.text: Poor soul, imagine being scared of talking squirrels and boats!

response.speaker: Fantastic Boat
response.text: #Haha, well, we can't blame {M#him}{F#her}. After all, humans aren't quite accustomed to hearing things like us talk.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Wait... have you guys always been able to talk?

response.speaker: Squirrel
response.text: Of course! Otherwise, how would we communicate with others of our kind?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So in other words... we suddenly gained the ability to understand you? How strange...

response.speaker: Squirrel
response.text: Maybe you've gained some intelligence. Congratulations.

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: #So, you're finally awake, {NICKNAME}? Time to rise and shine!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: You're back!

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: Yes, we went for a little walk. The enchanting scenery and pleasant weather here soothes the body and mind.

response.speaker: Oz
response.text: Everything is fine, except that some places are a little peculiar...

response.speaker: Fischl
response.text: Hohoho! The servants of darkness have descended. Rejoice, for the return of the Immernachtreich is nigh!

response.speaker: Oz
response.text: Mein Fräulein means that this is an unexpected development, and she has never seen anything like this before.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: No, that's not even close to what she said!

response.speaker: Oz
response.text: My apologies. Please take that as my own opinion.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: What happened?

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: After last night, there have been some... unusual spectacles on this island.

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: Yes. Swimming birds, flying squirrels, the sun and moon in the sky together... Some of these sights only lasted for a moment, but that doesn't make it any less bizarre.

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: I heard a strange flapping sound on the island, but didn't see a single flying creature around.

response.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
response.text: There was also a peculiar floral scent on the wind. Though there are many flowers on this island, that scent did not resemble any of them.

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: Seems to me like whatever these things are, they aren't visible to the naked eye...

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: I tried to perform a divination, but my scryglass showed only a chaotic mess that was impossible to decipher.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, Paimon has a bad feeling about this... What have we gotten ourselves into...

response.speaker: Fischl
response.text: Hmm... I had resolved to summon the Immernachtreich in this land, but now we observe these puzzling phenomena... Could this be the spawn of the condemned, trying to thwart my sacred endeavor?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Wait, {NICKNAME}... you don't think Alice could be behind all this, do you?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But if it really was her, it wouldn't make sense to do all this...

response.speaker: Squirrel
response.text: Hahaha, look at them, old chap, seems we scared the pants off them!

response.speaker: Fantastic Boat
response.text: Aye, well, they've never seen anything like this before.

response.speaker: Fantastic Boat
response.text: This old boat's sailed all over the briney seas in its time, and tried talking to many a sailor, too. But in all that time, not a single person has ever spoken back.

response.speaker: Squirrel
response.text: Exactly. If it weren't for this environment, who would've thought humans would be able to chat with us?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: This environment? What do you mean by that?

response.speaker: Mona
response.text: The environment... Could it be that... the environment is what's interfering with my divinations?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh... even if you were...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Dreams aren't supposed to become reality, right? And a dream won't make you suddenly understand boats and squirrels... Aah!

response.speaker: Xinyan
response.text: What's wrong?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Look! Over there!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We're back!

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Hey, look, that whole mountain's changed completely.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: ... Wait.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Everyone, I might have an explanation. The changes in the mirage could be related to the bonsai.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: My father once mentioned that this pot was originally part of a collection belonging to my great-grandfather. He adored his bonsai and always took great care of them.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: When our family fell upon hard times, my grandfather traveled far and wide, looking for a way to save the clan. However, during that time, my great-grandfather became gravely ill.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: He knew my grandfather had no interest in bonsai, so before his death, he gave most of his carefully crafted bonsai away. This is the only one he retained.

dialogues.speaker: Squirrel
dialogues.text: Hey friend. Your eyes betray your thoughts — you still look very bemused.

dialogues.speaker: Squirrel
dialogues.text: Oh, come now, do you see me acting surprised at the sudden arrival of you and your party? Well then. I'm sure we can get along quite amicably.

dialogues.speaker: Squirrel
dialogues.text: If you want to know where the most scrumptious pinecones are, come find me anytime!

dialogues.speaker: Squirrel
dialogues.text: Ah... Mondstadt. I wonder what it's really like...

dialogues.speaker: Miitoboru
dialogues.text: Good going, lads and lassies! Miitoboru admires your bravery.

dialogues.speaker: Miitoboru
dialogues.text: How long have you been here? Oh, it's not your first time? Haha, well I never.

dialogues.speaker: Miitoboru
dialogues.text: We're almost there! Please take all yer personal belongings with ye, and mind your step as you disembark!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Look, there's something over there.

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Wow, it's...

dialogues.speaker: Kaedehara Kazuha
dialogues.text: Let's take a closer look.

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: I heard an old man say something about the "Kaedeharas"...

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: Sounds like it might be Kazuha's grandfather.

dialogues.speaker: Oz
dialogues.text: I believe the other voice belongs to Lord Kazuha's father.

dialogues.speaker: Fischl
dialogues.text: Oh? I see... We have ventured into Lord Kazuha's memory.

dialogues.speaker: Xinyan
dialogues.text: Looks like a letter Kazuha wrote while he was traveling.

dialogues.speaker: Mona
dialogues.text: What a sad letter...

dialogues.speaker: Fischl
dialogues.text: ...Lord Kazuha...
